hasDefinedTerm.name: CreatorOps
hasDefinedTerm.description: The operational framework, automated workflows, and software infrastructure used by digital creators and media teams to produce, repurpose, and distribute multi-channel content efficiently.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI Content Repurposing
hasDefinedTerm.description: The automated process of extracting high-engagement segments from long-form video or audio and reformatting them into platform-native vertical shorts with subtitles and visual hooks.
